model.clinical_claims_dv.bridge_patient_.name: bridge_patient_coverage
model.clinical_claims_dv.bridge_patient_.description: Bridge: patient to payer coverage periods (from payer transitions), latest version of each period.
model.clinical_claims_dv.bridge_patient_.raw_code:
-- Bridge: patient -> payer coverage periods (from payer transitions)
select
    l.PATIENT_HK,
    l.PAYER_HK,
    l.PAYER_TRANSITION_HK,
    s.MEMBER_ID,
    s.START_YEAR as COVERAGE_START,
    s.END_YEAR   as COVERAGE_END,
    s.SECONDARY_PAYER_ID,
    s.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    current_timestamp() as BRIDGE_BUILT_AT
from {{ ref('lnk_payer_transition_patient_payer') }} l
join {{ ref('sat_payer_transition_details') }} s
  on s.PAYER_TRANSITION_HK = l.PAYER_TRANSITION_HK
qualify row_number() over (partition by s.PAYER_TRANSITION_HK order by s.LOAD_DATETIME desc) = 1

model.clinical_claims_dv.bv_claim_financ.name: bv_claim_financials
model.clinical_claims_dv.bv_claim_financ.description: Claim header joined to rolled-up claim transactions: charges, payments, adjustments and outstanding balance.
model.clinical_claims_dv.bv_claim_financ.raw_code:
-- Claim-level financials: claim header + rolled-up transaction amounts
with claim as (
    select * from {{ ref('sat_claim_details') }}
    qualify row_number() over (partition by CLAIM_HK order by LOAD_DATETIME desc) = 1
),
tx as (
    select
        l.CLAIM_HK,
        count(*)            as TX_COUNT,
        sum(s.AMOUNT)       as TOTAL_CHARGED,
        sum(s.PAYMENTS)     as TOTAL_PAYMENTS,
        sum(s.ADJUSTMENTS)  as TOTAL_ADJUSTMENTS,
        sum(s.OUTSTANDING)  as TOTAL_OUTSTANDING
    from {{ ref('lnk_claim_tx_claim_patient') }} l
    join {{ ref('sat_claim_tx_details') }} s on s.CLAIM_TX_HK = l.CLAIM_TX_HK
    group by l.CLAIM_HK
)
select
    h.CLAIM_HK,
    h.CLAIM_ID,
    lc.PATIENT_HK,
    lc.PROVIDER_HK,
    lc.ENCOUNTER_HK,
    claim.SERVICEDATE,
    claim.STATUS1, claim.STATUS2, claim.STATUSP,
    claim.OUTSTANDING1, claim.OUTSTANDING2, claim.OUTSTANDINGP,
    tx.TX_COUNT, tx.TOTAL_CHARGED, tx.TOTAL_PAYMENTS, tx.TOTAL_ADJUSTMENTS, tx.TOTAL_OUTSTANDING
from {{ ref('hub_claim') }} h
left join {{ ref('lnk_claim_patient_provider_encounter') }} lc on lc.CLAIM_HK = h.CLAIM_HK
left join claim on claim.CLAIM_HK = h.CLAIM_HK
left join tx on tx.CLAIM_HK = h.CLAIM_HK

model.clinical_claims_dv.pit_patient.name: pit_patient
model.clinical_claims_dv.pit_patient.description: Point-in-time table: for each patient and as-of date, the satellite row keys and load times that were current. Built with AutomateDV pit().
model.clinical_claims_dv.pit_patient.compiled_code:
-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.STAGING.stg_patients

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.BUSINESS_VAULT.as_of_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.STAGING.stg_patients
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.BUSINESS_VAULT.pit_patient
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.PATIENT_HK
    FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.hub_patient AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATETIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.BUSINESS_VAULT.pit_patient AS a
    INNER JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.hub_patient as b
        ON a.PATIENT_HK = b.PATIENT_HK
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.PATIENT_HK,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.PATIENT_HK,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_details_src.PATIENT_HK),
                 
                 CAST(repeat('0', 32) AS BINARY(16)))
                 
        AS sat_patient_details_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_details_src.LOAD_DATETIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000000'))
        AS sat_patient_details_LDTS,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_pii_src.PATIENT_HK),
                 
                 CAST(repeat('0', 32) AS BINARY(16)))
                 
        AS sat_patient_pii_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_pii_src.LOAD_DATETIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000000'))
        AS sat_patient_pii_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.sat_patient_details AS sat_patient_details_src
            ON a.PATIENT_HK = sat_patient_details_src.PATIENT_HK
            AND sat_patient_details_src.LOAD_DATETIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

        LEFT OUTER JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.sat_patient_pii AS sat_patient_pii_src
            ON a.PATIENT_HK = sat_patient_pii_src.PATIENT_HK
            AND sat_patient_pii_src.LOAD_DATETIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.PATIENT_HK, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.PATIENT_HK,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.hub_patient AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.PATIENT_HK,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_details_src.PATIENT_HK),
                 CAST(repeat('0', 32) AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_patient_details_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_details_src.LOAD_DATETIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000000'))
        AS sat_patient_details_LDTS,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_pii_src.PATIENT_HK),
                 CAST(repeat('0', 32) AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_patient_pii_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_patient_pii_src.LOAD_DATETIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000000'))
        AS sat_patient_pii_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.sat_patient_details AS sat_patient_details_src
            ON a.PATIENT_HK = sat_patient_details_src.PATIENT_HK
            AND sat_patient_details_src.LOAD_DATETIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

        LEFT OUTER JOIN CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.RAW_VAULT.sat_patient_pii AS sat_patient_pii_src
            ON a.PATIENT_HK = sat_patient_pii_src.PATIENT_HK
            AND sat_patient_pii_src.LOAD_DATETIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.PATIENT_HK,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit


select * from CLINICAL_CLAIMS_DV.BUSINESS_VAULT.PIT_PATIENT;

{{ config(materialized='table', grants={'select': ['PARTNER_ANALYST']}) }}

-- Simulated partner upload: the payer partner's own member list, hashed with the agreed salt.
-- In a real two-account clean room this table lives in the partner's account.
-- Here: 1-in-3 sampled patients plus 2,000 keys we don't have, so overlap is realistic.
select sha2(PATIENT_ID::string || '{{ var("cleanroom_salt") }}', 256) as MEMBER_JOIN_KEY,
       'PARTNER_PAYER_CO' as PARTNER_NAME
from {{ ref('dim_patient') }}
where mod(PATIENT_ID, 3) = 0
union all
select sha2(('non_member_' || seq4())::string || '{{ var("cleanroom_salt") }}', 256), 'PARTNER_PAYER_CO'
from table(generator(rowcount => 2000))

model.clinical_claims_dv.dim_patient.name: dim_patient
model.clinical_claims_dv.dim_patient.description: Patient (member) dimension: demographics, age band, geography and income. Direct identifiers are masked unless PHI_READER is in session.
model.clinical_claims_dv.dim_patient.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

-- Patient dimension. A view (not a table) so tag-based masking is evaluated for the querying role.
select
    PATIENT_ID,
    PATIENT_HK,
    GENDER,
    RACE,
    ETHNICITY,
    MARITAL                                   as MARITAL_STATUS,
    BIRTHDATE,
    DEATHDATE,
    AGE,
    case
        when AGE < 18 then '0-17'
        when AGE < 35 then '18-34'
        when AGE < 50 then '35-49'
        when AGE < 65 then '50-64'
        else '65+'
    end                                       as AGE_BAND,
    IS_ALIVE,
    CITY,
    COUNTY,
    STATE,
    ZIP,
    INCOME,
    HEALTHCARE_EXPENSES,

left join {{ ref('dim_payer') }} p on p.PAYER_ID = f.PAYER_ID
group by 1, 2, 3

select
    c.CLAIM_ID,
    hp.PATIENT_ID,

    coalesce(c.TOTAL_OUTSTANDING, 0)           as TOTAL_OUTSTANDING,
    coalesce(c.OUTSTANDING1, 0) + coalesce(c.OUTSTANDING2, 0) + coalesce(c.OUTSTANDINGP, 0) as HEADER_OUTSTANDING

left join {{ ref('hub_patient') }} hp on hp.PATIENT_HK = c.PATIENT_HK

macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro snowflake__get_catalog_tables_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as "table_database",
        table_schema as "table_schema",
        table_name as "table_name",
        case
            when is_dynamic = 'YES' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE' THEN 'DYNAMIC TABLE'
            else table_type
        end as "table_type",
        comment as "table_comment",

        -- note: this is the _role_ that owns the table
        table_owner as "table_owner",

        'Clustering Key' as "stats:clustering_key:label",
        clustering_key as "stats:clustering_key:value",
        'The key used to cluster this table' as "stats:clustering_key:description",
        (clustering_key is not null) as "stats:clustering_key:include",

        'Row Count' as "stats:row_count:label",
        row_count as "stats:row_count:value",
        'An approximate count of rows in this table' as "stats:row_count:description",
        (row_count is not null) as "stats:row_count:include",

        'Approximate Size' as "stats:bytes:label",
        bytes as "stats:bytes:value",
        'Approximate size of the table as reported by Snowflake' as "stats:bytes:description",
        (bytes is not null) as "stats:bytes:include",

        'Last Modified' as "stats:last_modified:label",
        to_varchar(convert_timezone('UTC', last_altered), 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI'||'UTC') as "stats:last_modified:value",
        'The timestamp for last update/change' as "stats:last_modified:description",
        (last_altered is not null and table_type='BASE TABLE') as "stats:last_modified:include"
    from {{ information_schema }}.tables
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.name: snowflake__get_catalog_columns_sql
macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro snowflake__get_catalog_columns_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as "table_database",
        table_schema as "table_schema",
        table_name as "table_name",

        column_name as "column_name",
        ordinal_position as "column_index",
        data_type as "column_type",
        comment as "column_comment"
    from {{ information_schema }}.columns
{%- endmacro %}

{% macro optional(name, value, quote_char = '') %}
{#-
--  Insert optional DDL parameters only when their value is provided; makes DDL statements more readable
--
--  Args:
--  - name: the name of the DDL option
--  - value: the value of the DDL option, may be None
--  - quote_char: the quote character to use (e.g. string), leave blank if unnecessary (e.g. integer or bool)
--  Returns:
--      If the value is not None (e.g. provided by the user), return the option setting DDL
--      If the value is None, return an empty string
-#}
{% if value is not none %}{{ name }} = {{ quote_char }}{{ value }}{{ quote_char }}{% endif %}
{% endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.

---
